mxCell.value: ① User Signs Up (Clerk Auth — Email / Social)
② Create Company Profile POST /companies (name, type, city, CR, phone)
③ Platform Manually Reviews License & Documents
Rejected / Pending / Expired → Listing + Offer BLOCKED (403)
⑤ Producer Creates Waste Listing POST /listings (material, qty, price, targeting)
⑥ Buyer Submits Offer POST /listings/:id/offers (price_per_unit + eligibility check)
⑦ Producer Accepts Best Offer PUT /offers/:id/accept → Deal Created (status=active)
⑧ Buyer Pays Outside Platform → Producer Confirms Payment PUT /deals/:id/confirm-payment (payment_reference required)
⑨ Transport Decision (Optional) PUT /deals/:id/transport-decision platform | self_managed
⑩ Producer Confirms Dispatch PUT /deals/:id/confirm-dispatch (actual_qty required if by_weight)
⑪ Buyer Confirms Receipt PUT /deals/:id/confirm-receipt → Deal COMPLETED ✅
Note: Payment is off-platform (bank transfer or cheque). The platform records the confirmation only.
User registers via Clerk, creates a company profile, and waits for manual platform approval. Access to all operational features is gated on license_status = approved.
✅ Trigger: Clerk webhook creates user session No backend user table — user_id from Clerk JWT

POST /companies Create Company Profile ───────────────── name (2–120 chars) type: producer|buyer|carrier city (2–80 chars) commercialRegistration (CR) contactPhone (6–20 chars) → company_members (owner)
⚠ One company per user enforced (409 if duplicate)
Approved producers create waste listings. Listings have targeting, pricing model, and eligibility rules that control who may submit an offer.

Listing Fields ───────────────────────────── material_category_id (hierarchy) quantity + unit_option_id pricing_model: fixed | by_weight | revenue_share sale_type: auction | direct visibility: public | private targeting_type: open | category | specific_company eligible_company_type: ALL | LICENSED_ONLY listing_required_services (capability list)
eligible_company_type = LICENSED_ONLY → Buyer must have approved license + matching capability
① Producer manually DELETE /listings/:id (soft close, data preserved)
② Offer Accepted → listing auto-closed atomically with deal creation
Buyers submit price offers on open listings. A rules engine checks eligibility. The producer selects one offer; the rest are auto-rejected and a deal is created atomically.
✅ No existing offer from buyer on same listing (unique constraint)
✅ If LICENSED_ONLY: buyer capability + license match
Fail → 403 OwnListing | CompanyIncomplete | LicenseRequired | TargetingRestricted 409 OfferExists 422 CommercialRegistrationRequired
All other offers on same listing → status = rejected (atomic)
A deal is created atomically when an offer is accepted. It progresses through payment, dispatch, and receipt. Automated SLA expiry jobs monitor each stage.
PUT /deals/:id/confirm-dispatch Actor: Producer Requires: actual_quantity (if by_weight)
Terminal — SLA breach Triggered by: expire-deals.ts (auto-job)
Terminal — manual cancellation (admin or platform action)
⚠ by_weight pricing: actual_quantity (weighbridge) is required at confirm-dispatch Final price = actual_quantity × price_per_unit (instead of estimated qty)
✅ Deal Extension: extension_count tracked. extended_until overrides default SLA.
After payment confirmation, either party can open a transport request. Two modes: platform-managed (Tadweerah arranges transport) or self-managed (parties handle logistics directly).
✅ manifest_ref stored (MWAN eManifest alignment) ✅ waste_category_id, vehicle_plate, transporter_company_id captured ❌ Full MWAN API integration not yet implemented (Phase 2)
